import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Dataset provided as a string
data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep,
# while incorporating Stress Level (color) and Physical Activity Level (size) as additional dimensions.
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 7))
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Stress Level',  # Color points based on Stress Level
    size='Physical Activity Level',  # Size points based on Physical Activity Level
    sizes=(50, 400),  # Range for marker sizes
    palette='viridis',  # Choose a color palette for stress levels
    alpha=0.8,  # Transparency for better visibility of overlapping points
    legend='full' # Show full legend for hue and size
)

plt.title('Sleep Duration vs. Quality of Sleep by Stress Level and Physical Activity', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)

# Improve readability with a grid
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

# Adjust legend placement to prevent overlap with the plot area
plt.legend(title='Stress Level / Physical Activity', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0.)
plt.tight_layout() # Adjust layout to prevent labels from being cut off

# Save the plot to a file
